items.title: 2.2 Masla hal karne ke qadam aur algorithms (heading scan mein nahi) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the surviving end of section 2.2 and Figure 2.2 (PDF 26, printed 22); printed page 21 is missing from the scan.

blocks.title: Is hisse ka kuch hissa source mein maujood nahi
blocks.text: Scan wali kitab mein chhapa hua safha 21 maujood nahi. Is liye section 2.2 ki heading, us ka shuru ka text aur Figure 2.1 yahan nahi diye ja sakte. Yeh lesson sirf bacha hua hissa deta hai: agle safhe par section ka aakhri hissa aur Figure 2.2. Upar ka unwan (title) hamara diya hua hai, kitab ka chhapa hua nahi.

(Jumla pichhle, gum shuda safhe se shuru hota hai.) … sahi tarteeb (correct order) mein. Is se masla hal karte waqt ghaltiyan nahi hotin. Koi bhi in steps ko aasani se samajh aur istemal kar sakta hai. Computer bhi step-by-step instructions (hidayat) par chalte hain (Figure 2.2 dekhein). Achhi planning sahi nateeje deti hai.

blocks.alt: Step-by-Step Algorithm Example ki heading ke neeche flowchart: Start, Boil Water (pani ubalein), Steep Tea (patti bhigoyein), Add Milk or Lemon (doodh ya lemon dalein), Serve Tea (chai pesh karein), End, teeron se jure. Saath mein ketli, tea bag wala cup, doodh, cheeni aur lemon, aur lemon wala cup.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.2: Qadam ba qadam algorithm ki misal (kitab ki Figure 2.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 2.2 chai banane ka algorithm hai: Start, pani ubalein (Boil Water), patti dalein (Steep Tea), doodh ya lemon dalein, chai pesh karein (Serve Tea), End. Har step ek hi baar aur sahi tarteeb mein aata hai. Agar tarteeb badal dein (maslan pehle chai pesh karein, phir pani ubalein) to nateeja ghalat hoga. Yahi baat text kehta hai: sahi tarteeb ghaltiyan rokti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Chapter ke Summary ke mutabiq: Decomposition bare ya mushkil masle ko chhote aur sambhalne ke qabil hisson mein torna hai. Algorithm kisi masle ko hal karne ya koi kaam karne ki step-by-step hidayat ka set hai. Exercise ka MCQ 2 batata hai ke masla hal karne ka pehla step masle ko pehchanna (identify karna) hai.

blocks.prompt: Decomposition ko ek misal se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Decomposition bare masle ko aise chhote hisson mein torti hai jo ek ek kar ke hal ho sakein. Misal: school ki result sheet banana. Isay hisson mein torein: marks jama karna, har student ka total, percentage aur grade nikalna, aur sheet print karna. Har hissa aasan hai aur sab mil kar poora masla hal karte hain.

items: Chhapa hua safha 21 (2.2 ki heading, Figure 2.1) scan mein nahi.
Sahi tarteeb ke steps ghaltiyan rokte hain; computer bhi step-by-step chalte hain (Figure 2.2, chai ka algorithm).
Decomposition: masle ko chhote hisson mein torna; algorithm: tarteeb wale steps.
